name: Braelynn
biography: Braelynn is a security consultant at Leviathan Security Group where she conducts security assessments of products for startups, Fortune 500 companies, and everything in between. She enjoys partaking in CTFs and researching the security anything that piques her curiosity. She has previously presented this research at conferences such as Chaos Communication Congress.
